businessContext: The gym is growing and currently relies on spreadsheets, paper signups, and ad hoc schedules. The owner is frustrated by missed class bookings and inconsistent member records.
communicationStyle: Busy, practical, and wants to know what the software will fix in day-to-day operations. Avoids jargon and wants clear operational outcomes.
goals: Keep class attendance and check-ins under control
Reduce missed payments and manual admin
constraints: The business has peak-hour check-in pressure
The owner wants a low-friction rollout
Membership and billing rules are more important than feature breadth
nonNegotiables: The system must preserve member access rules
The business needs reliable daily visibility
Billing and cancellations must be tracked accurately
ambiguityPoints: They do not specify whether there are multiple branches or franchise locations
They mention classes but not equipment or trainer scheduling complexity
They are vague about payment and contract rules at the start
